long_biography.plain_text:
Mike Slade's offshore racing programme gave younger sailors experience alongside established professionals. Working with skipper Chris Sherlock, the British property entrepreneur sustained campaigns across major international races for more than three decades. His teams pursued records and outright wins, while also providing training in demanding offshore conditions. Sailors who passed through the programme went on to compete in the America's Cup and the Volvo Ocean Race.

Slade also helped turn LandAid into a professionally run charity supporting homes for young people facing homelessness. As its president, he drew on the property industry's fundraising capacity and encouraged colleagues to support its work. His services to charity brought an OBE in 2019.

confidence.reason: RORC directly describes training and subsequent sailor careers; primary interview and Helical retirement release support charitable role and honour.
